assetBoundary: Only separately Apache-2.0-licensed Google Roboto and Open Sans font bytes from the retained distribution are embedded; no proprietary Axure code or assets are packaged.
stage: Source-backed Layer author resize, shared selection frames, native resize pins and current-view transactions
limitations: Layer author resizing supports closed ordinary/member types and nested Layers. Unsupported composite members, mixed Layer/ordinary selections, empty/zero/nonfinite/out-of-model frames are rejected atomically.

Multi-Layer handle projection uses a shared selection frame. Multi-Layer Inspector width/height applies the requested own size to each selected Layer as an independently tested product convention; the original numeric multi-selection UI contract is not established.
Shift aspect-lock entry conditions, Layer author rotation, all composite native setters and remaining native fixed/relative metadata are incomplete.
Native import remains a strict partial recovery. Native RP writeback, original editor canvas/pixel comparison, cloud collaboration and full Axure parity remain incomplete.
